Vim, the leading healthcare technology company powering seamless connections at the point of care, today announced the growing momentum of Vim Connect, its combined developer platform and application marketplace designed to make it easier for health-tech innovators to bring solutions directly into care teams’ workflows.

Vim Connect is a developer-first platform that removes integration complexity and speeds time to market. By providing APIs, SDKs, and turnkey distribution channels, it enables health-tech innovators to build faster, distribute smarter through the Vim Connect Marketplace, and scale farther across a nationwide footprint of healthcare organizations.

> “Vim Connect was purpose-built to bridge the gap between impactful solutions and the clinical and administrative workflows where they matter most.”
>
> — Asaf David, CTO at Vim

Health-tech innovators are already leveraging Vim Connect to create solutions across AI scribing, risk adjustment and quality, revenue cycle automation, patient affordability and medication management, and referrals and care coordination — including Heidi Health, Kennar Health, FRQ Technologies, Scribe AI, Protego, and Playback.

### About Vim

Vim builds healthcare infrastructure for the real world. As a next-generation developer platform, Vim connects payers, providers, EHRs, and digital health innovators through a shared workflow layer that lives directly in the clinical moment. Learn more at getvim.com.
